{How did Maxime Vachier-Lagrave (MVL), start a strong attack?} 24. Rd6 {
[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.]
[%hint Find a strong outpost for your d1-rook so that if Black captures it,
there will be fewer defenders of the f7-pawn.]} (24. Rxd7 $2 Rxd7 {Black
recaptures with a safe position. Try again and look for a stronger rook move.})
(24. Ra1 $2 Rd4 {Black dominates the e-file with a good game. Try again and
look for a better rook move.}) (24. h5 $2 Rxd1 {Black wins a rook. Try again
and look for a strong rook move.}) 24... Rxd6 {Great idea! What's next?} 25.
exd6 {[%wrong There's a much stronger move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Recapture and attack the black queen.]} Rxd6 {Nice move! How
did MVL win back the sacrifice material and maintain a strong attack?} 26. Nxf7
{[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a powerful attacking
move.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight to decoy the black queen away from the
d6-rook.] Well played! Black can't safely recapture on f7 without losing the
d6-rook. White had a vicious attack and later won in Vachier Lagrave -Aronian,
2018.} (26. Nh5+ $5 {This is a great move, but MVL preferred a strong capture.
Try to find his idea as well.}) (26. Qe5+ $2 f6 {White can get a good position
with Nxe6+, but there's a stronger attacking move. Try to find it.}) (26. Rd1
$2 Rxd1+ {Black captures the rook with check and then wins the queen. Try
again and look for a better attacking move.}) *

{White has just captured on c5, but Black doesn't need to recapture right away.
How should you fight for the initiative?} 7... Qa5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a way to develop and make a pin.] [%hint Develop
and pin the c3-knight.]} (7... dxc5 $2 8. O-O {White has better center control
and an advantage. Try again and look for a useful developing move.}) (7... Nc6
$2 8. O-O {White gives back the pawn with a good position. Try again and look
for a good capture.}) 8. cxd6 {Great start! White would have been better off
castling and simply giving back the pawn on c5. Now Black can develop a quick
attack. What should you play?} Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again
and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and attack the pinned
knight.]} (8... exd6 $2 9. Nd2 {White unpins c3 and defends e4, with a good
position. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 9. dxe7 {Nice move! How
should you save your rook?} Re8 {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try again
and look for a way to save your rook.] [%hint Find a safe square for your rook.
] Good work! Black has the much safer king and will soon win back material on
c3 or e7.} (9... Bxc3+ $2 10. bxc3 {Black's OK, but will likely regret giving
up the powerful g7-bishop. Try again and look for a way to save your rook.}) (
9... Nxc3 $2 10. exf8=Q+ {White wins the rook with check. Try again and look
for a way to save your rook.}) *
